summary: This is a GitHub pull request page (ros-controls/ros2_control PR #1240) titled '[HW Interface] Change creation, exportation and storing of Command-/StateInterface + Support for variant'. The PR, opened by mamueluth, moves creation of Command/StateInterfaces from hardware components to the framework via on_export_state_interface() and on_export_command_interface(), stores values directly in handles using std::variant, and adds set_state/get_state and set_command/get_command functions. Reviews from destogl and saikishor request changes around deprecation handling, testing of custom-exported interfaces, and naming, and the author responds with updates.
one_line: GitHub pull request #1240 in ros2_control moving Command/StateInterface creation to the framework and adding std::variant handle support.
key_facts: GitHub pull request #1240 in the ros-controls/ros2_control repository is titled '[HW Interface] Change creation, exportation and storing of Command-/StateInterface + Support for variant'.
The pull request was opened by mamueluth and proposes merging 22 commits from the StoglRobotics-forks:change_interface_export_variant branch into ros-controls:master.
The pull request shows +2,735 and -216 changes across 25 files, with 127 conversation items and 11 checks.

mamueluth's December 20, 2023 comment states the concept is fully backward compatible, has been tested, and that the example_1 in the ros2_control_demos repository (PR 396) was adapted to showcase the changes.
The creation of Command-/StateInterface is no longer handled by the hardware component (user) but by the Framework, which creates them from interface definitions parsed from the URDF.
An InterfaceDescription encapsulates interface information parsed from the URDF, including data_type, default_values, min and max.
The Command-/StateInterface now store the value directly in the handle, and the value is of type std::variant so handles can support datatypes other than double.
The export_command/state_interfaces_2() function is planned to be renamed to export_command/state_interfaces() once the deprecated version is removed.
Codecov reported patch coverage of 55.21472% with 146 lines missing coverage, and project coverage changed from 75.51% on master to 48.20% at the PR head.

On January 22, 2024, destogl requested changes, suggesting the deprecated approach be abstracted at the component level rather than in the ResourceManager, so that on_export_* methods are not needed inside components.
destogl also noted that a test with a custom component exporting a manually defined interface not defined in the URDF is missing, and that this functionality should be kept and tested.
mamueluth explained that the added URDF test assets mimic the hardware in test_component_interfaces.cpp so the same test can cover both the old and new export versions without regression.
On January 23, 2024, saikishor suggested changes including a shorter return type for on_export_state_interfaces using a StateInterfaceSharedPtr alias.
mamueluth responded on January 23, 2024 that on_export_function is now virtual and the states and commands are protected instead of private to allow overriding and adding custom interfaces.
